content.title: Weak contraction mapping and optimization
content.abstract: The weak contraction mapping is a self mapping that the range is always a subset of the domain, which admits a unique fixed-point. The iteration of weak contraction mapping is a Cauchy sequence that yields the unique fixed-point. A gradient-free optimization method as an application of weak contraction mapping is proposed to achieve global minimum convergence. The optimization method is robust to local minima and initial point position.
content.TL;DR: A gradient-free method is proposed for non-convex optimization problem
